description: This source file contains unit tests for the onboarding remote authentication prompt in a MacOS application. It tests various aspects such as error code mappings, UI element visibility, user messaging, and device pairing scenarios.

classes.name: OnboardingRemoteAuthPromptTests
classes.description: Struct containing multiple unit tests for remote authentication prompt behavior.

methods.name: `auth detail codes map to remote auth issues`
methods.description: Tests the mapping between specific auth error detail codes and the corresponding remote gateway auth issues.

methods.name: `password detail family maps to password required issue`
methods.description: Tests that password mismatch and not configured errors map to the password required issue.

methods.name: `token field visibility follows onboarding rules`
methods.description: Verifies the conditions under which the remote token input field should be shown based on various flags and error states.

methods.name: `pairing required copy points users to pair approve`
methods.description: Ensures that the pairing required issue presents appropriate messaging to the user, instructing them on approval steps.

methods.name: `paired device success copy explains auth source`
methods.description: Validates the success messages and details shown when a device is successfully paired via various auth sources.

methods.name: `transient probe mode restore does not clear probe feedback`
methods.description: Checks whether probe feedback is preserved or reset under specific conditions during mode transitions.
